features.title: Walk and explore
features.text: Roam the reading rooms and shelves in first person. Climb, jump and look around at your own pace.

features.title: Chat with others
features.text: Talk to the people in the library. Every name floats above their head with a label: Student, Staff or Admin.

features.title: Play chess
features.text: Sit at a computer and play the computer, or open an online room and share its code with a friend.

features.title: Borrow books
features.text: Pick a book from a shelf. The request is reserved on the website too, and a QR code is emailed to you for pickup.

features.title: Fill your trolley
features.text: Every shelf has its own category. Look at one, press E to browse its books, add them to the cart and push the trolley to the desk to check out.

features.title: Word duel
features.text: Sit at the table by the window and wait for a second player. Pick a category first, then race to guess the same word. Best of 3.

features.title: Meet the people
features.text: Shan, Dave, Ash and Rowin each have a few facts to share. Walk up, look at them and press E.

features.title: Meet the cat
features.text: Somebody has to guard the books. Say hello and give the library cat a pet.

features.title: More on the way
features.text: New rooms, activities and events are added over time. Watch the library news for updates.

keys.action: Use what you are looking at (shelves, trolley, people, computers, the cat)

phone.title: On a phone
phone.text: Open the game and it fills your screen: turn your phone sideways. Use the left thumb stick to walk, drag anywhere else to look around, and tap the button that appears (Browse, Push, Talk, Join game) to use what you are looking at.
